Data flows left to right; commands return along the bottom. The pose reaches every block through tf2 and is not drawn: lidar de-skew, fusion and the behaviour tree read it there.
Rates are targets. Only the vehicle layer's drivers change between the ADS-DV and 1:10 profiles; the other layers take the profile's numbers (size, limits) as parameters.
